note: Every frame of result.png/assembled.png/demo.mp4 is a real screenshot of the figure rendered by Chrome Headless Shell + SwiftShader WebGL -- no synthesized or interpolated frames. loop.png's cells come from real grade.sh verdicts in media/data/ (collect_data.sh).

result.png.what: Exploded-view showcase capture of the real figure (?shot&labels&explode=0.72, yaw 35) rendered by Chrome Headless Shell + SwiftShader at 1920x1080, with a verdict band drawn from the measured values in verdict-good.json.

assembled.png.what: The same scene fully assembled (?shot&labels=0, yaw 35): a raw real screenshot, no annotation.

loop.png.what: Mutant x gate matrix: examples/good plus the 7 single-edit mutants against all 6 judge gates. Red cells carry the measured value that broke the gate.

demo.mp4.what: 21 s turntable + exploded-view animation assembled from 630 real rendered frames (no interpolation), h264 crf 18; lossless master in media/master/ (git-ignored).
